notes: 6.8.3: real-time voice captions no longer show a sentence twice (an utterance's recognition result could land after the next utterance began and re-commit the whole thing). Video subtitle tasks: the GPU queue wait is stated in the log instead of looking hung for 20+ minutes, symbol-only "…" cues are dropped (643 of 1974 in one real file), sources over 256 MB are no longer copied into the working folder (one 4-video batch copied 24 GB; temp had grown past 100 GB) and that folder is now kept under 20 GB. Repeated subtitle lines are translated per scene instead of sharing one translation. / 6.8.3：实时语音翻译不再出现同一句显示两遍（上一句的识别结果可能在下一句开始后才回来，导致整段被重新提交）。视频字幕任务：等待 GPU 时日志会写明排队情况，不再像卡死二十多分钟；纯符号「…」字幕不再写进结果（实测一个文件 1974 条里有 643 条）；超过 256 MB 的源文件不再复制进临时目录（一批四个视频曾复制 24 GB，临时目录堆到上百 GB），并将该目录控制在 20 GB 以内。字幕中重复的台词现在按场景分别翻译，不再共用同一个译文。
